source.name: TD Bank / Delaware North (stories.td.com): TD Bank and Delaware North Extend TD Garden Naming Rights Through 2045
source.quote: today announced a historic 20-year naming rights extension that keeps the beloved landmark and arena name as "TD Garden” through 2045

note: Arena naming rights: TD Garden. Start date kept null: arena naming rights began in July 2005 under TD Banknorth (the source says 'TD Bank has been the exclusive naming rights partner ... since July 1, 2005', but TD Bank took the brand only after the 2008 merger). Financial terms not disclosed.
